A concerned parent happened to be watching the live stream at Parker – Chase preschool 2022 in Roswell, Georgia. 
The parent noticed several cases of the children being pushed poked, and even one had their hand stepped on. She immediately called the police who arrested the two teachers Zeina Alostwani and Soriana Briceno, were arrested and charged with first-degree cruelty to children • .

The state moved to revoke the preschool's license due to gross negligence, but the school reached a settlement, paid a $10,000 fine, and agreed to additional training and monitoring to stay open.
As you can imagine, the parents vehemently disagreed with this. The cases judge refused herself it languages to this day in legal proceedings.

How fortunate these monsters were stupid enough to live stream their cruelty! 🤬
